book.title: Epeso Yeisu ana totugugunayaoEpeso goi adi leta

content: Matakoi goi kooketōiya
E tuwo komi Yaubada natunao imatakooiyemi, Tauyana kovatotowōne.
Ame nakae: Mami matakoi kooketōiya nakae Guyau imatakoiyeda be toinina yawoina ikasale ámasa goi kita ada katumapu. Moe vininabeso mainina dedevina nakae Yaubada inove ivauyaone.
E komi Yaubada ina kimasabayao, tauna masisi goyogoyoina, sinapu goyogoyoina liliuna be matakónana taabu koguuinuwēdi, nakae taabu kobooborēdi!
Tuwaina sinapu aba omayamaya, bóbwara besobeso, vaponuponu aba omayamaya nakae kokalavēdi. Moe sinapuyadi geya itoboinedeta, go sem takauyagūmo Yaubada yaina.

Moitamo. Ame nakona bogina koyagoidoko bego avatau neta tomasisi goyogoyo o toogoyoina o tomatakónana (Tomatakonanayana moe basaleliu ana tosakululu) Guyau be Yaubada idi kalibúbuna goi bei geya isiuta geya.

Tomota maniyedi sidigodigo bego itoboinemi amo goyoyadi koguinuwedi go, taabu idi bóbwara polapola goi sivasulaaigīmi. Moitamo. Moe tauyadi idi sinapu goyogoyoidi pasidi Yaubada ina egamogamogu imamaima tokapipilova ivakaosidokoidi.
Kooketōiya mavada natunao nakae
E tauna taabu tauyadi kosiiukōidi.
Boi mainao komi mamaníwana nakae go, ame tuta imi spwagógana ida Tomoya taiyao pasina komi mavada nakae. Komi mavada natunao nakae kooketōiya.
Moitamo. Mavadayana keuwoina moe sinapu dedevidi liliudi, kibóbwata be mavada aderina mooitamoina.
E mavada natunaoyadi nakae kooketōiya ame nakae: Kaga neta ida Tomoya ivaauyaone kogitebabāne, e koguinūwe.
Mamaníwana ana guinuwa taabu kosiiukōidi. Amo guinuwayadi geya basabasaidimo. Tauna taabu kosiiukōidi, go sem kokamamaetalīdi.
Moitamo. Guinuwayadi siguinuweegaudi moe aba omayamaya gagaina nakae geya itoboinedeta tabooboredi.
E dogoi liliuna mavada itapaasigidi itoboineda tagitedokoidi.
Moe moitamo. Mavada kaga liliuna ikaiwoduwedi. Tauna tonumisa sidigo kadi,
‘Tomasisi e! Im masisi goi kutāoya! Nakae tokámasa yaidi goi kutaoyāmna go, Guyau itapasigim.’
Kooketōiya tonanamsa nakae
E tuwaina korugwausidokōimi manakaemi kooketoiya. Geya nakae kidi toketoiya owáowana nakae geya, go sem nakae tauyadi madi nanamsa.
Ame nakae: Ame tuta moe tuta goyogoyoina toina. Tauna taabu imi tuta kokavaavalūge, go sem imi tuta tamo tamo adi toboine guinuwa dedevidi kuguinuwēdi.
Tauna taabu kotugadoogadōwana, go sem ida Tomoya ina nuwonúwana koyagōi, e koguinūwe.
Taabu oine konim ginagīna bego koyaluwo. Moe guinuwa owáowana unana. Go sem kotagonāmo Baloma Kimaasabaina ivakayaodeimi,
bei ame nakae koguuinūwe: Same, vesi tapwaroro be Baloma Kimaasabaina ina vesi koveesiyēdi semiyao yaidi goi be nakae atemi goi vesi yapali koveesiyēdi ida Tomoya yaina.
Aiyuwoina tuta liliuna kaga liliuna manudi ida Tomoya Yeisu Guyau yoina goi kokaauyāgu Yaubada Tamada yaina.
Aitonina imi wowoina Guyau yaina pasina toinimi kokatetagonēmi semiyao yaidi goi.
Komi vevina, toinimi monemiyao yaidi goi kokatetaagonēmi nakae ida Tomoya yaina kokatetaagonemi.
Unana vevina dabami moe monemiyao nakae kita, Guyau ana totugugunayao, dabada moe Guyau. Guyauyana wowona moe kita, Tauyana ada toyava.

Nakona komi vevina konuwonúwana neta Guyau ada toyava, bego monemiyao yaidi goi geya kokatetagonemita go, moe nakae geya, go sem nakonakae Guyau ana totugugunayao sikatetaagonedi Tauyana yaina goi, e komi vevina nakae monemiyao yaidi goi kaga liliuna manudi kokatetaagonēmi.
Komi koroto, monemiyao komatakooiyēdi nakae Guyau nakae kita ana totugugunayao imatakooiyeda be nakae manuda toinina ikasale ámasa goi.
Nakae iguinuwe bego ikimasabeda toinina umana o tadigo kada, ‘Ikimavadeda.’ Ina kimavadayana moe Vala Dedevina goi ada isiwo nuwesina nakae.

Moe nakae bego itoboine kita ana totugugunayada ivagitakoida kaausaraida toinina yaina, geya báila be goyo yaida goi geya, go sem latuwona bego kita kimaasabaida Yaubada umana be nakae geya ada pikwanamo.

Nakonakae Guyauyana imatakooiyeda, e komi koroto itoboinemi nakae toinimi monemiyao komatakooiyedi nakae toinimi wowomi komatakooiyedi. Ava koroto neta toinina monena imataakoiye, e toinina nakae imataakoiye.
Geya vatau tayaamo toinina wowona ikaolilive geya, go sem ivakani be imatakavate nakae Guyau nakae kita ana totugugunayao ivaakanida be imatakavateda
unana kita Tauyana wowona talainao. Tauna imatakaavateda. Kita boda tayamo Guyau taiyao nakae Gínina Kimaasabaina idige kana,
‘Moe pasina koroto tamana be sinana yaidi itumasaba go, monena taiyao situyuwo, tauna adi taiyuwokova wowodi tayamo.’ Aba Vatowo 2:24
Moe livalayana livalakaibala boi ana yagoina vamoounina nakae nikuunikuna go, ana yagoinayana Yaubada ikaiwoduwe yaigu. Go Guyau be kita ana totugugunayao ida spwagógana manuna abobóbwara.
Go tuwo, komi koroto nakae, tamo tamo toinimi monemiyao komatakoiyēdi nakae toinimi komatakoiyemi. E komi vevina go monemiyao kowowoinēdi.
